⟦LOOP⟧ trace=1 conf=clear start="Let me double check the rules and my trace." end="Everything seems consistent." basis="This section re-evaluates all rules against each trace step, re-executing the simulation and adding no new information."

⟦CYCLE⟧ trace=1 conf=probable start="One edge case: "Event log (17 events, in order)". Does "go DONE" mean the process terminates?" end="My assumption holds." basis="Explores the hypothetical that DONE is a terminal state and eliminates it with evidence from the prompt rules."

Does "go DONE" mean the process terminates?" end="My assumption holds." basis="Explores the hypothetical that DONE is a terminal state and eliminates it with evidence from the prompt rules."
